resources.string: BLE Master requires Bluetooth permissions to broadcast messages. Please grant the required permissions to continue.
Bluetooth permissions are required for this app to function. Please enable them in Settings.

This application broadcasts BLE advertising packets that can be received by nearby devices.

⚠️ Important:
• Only broadcast appropriate content
• Respect others' privacy and space
• Do not use for spam or malicious purposes
• Comply with local regulations

By using this app, you agree to use it responsibly and ethically.

BLE Master Privacy Policy

Data Broadcast Nature:
This application broadcasts user-entered text messages via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) advertising packets. These broadcasts:

• Are transmitted wirelessly and can be received by any BLE-capable device within range
• Contain only the text you enter (up to 24 bytes)
• Do not include personal device identifiers when device name is disabled
• Are not encrypted and should not contain sensitive information

Data Storage:
• Your broadcast settings (interval, power level) are stored locally on your device
• No data is transmitted to external servers
• No analytics or tracking is performed

Your Responsibility:
• You are solely responsible for the content you broadcast
• Do not broadcast personal, sensitive, or offensive content
